goal: Insert resident Ollama as free first-pass relay processor
body: Dave approved using the already-resident local Ollama/Kaedra lane to save cloud tokens. Implement it as a non-privileged preprocessor in front of cloud/frontier relay handling: triage/classify, summarize long relay bodies, deduplicate, generate compact batons, and apply deterministic routing metadata. Escalate ambiguous/security-sensitive/code-changing/judgment-heavy work to Claude/Codex/etc. Do not let the local model grant permission, claim/close privileged work, mutate policy, or weaken provenance. Measure before/after cloud tokens and relay latency. Preserve Git/relay durability and NouGenMsg delivery.

relay.note: Actionable-heavy: Relay pipeline/routing code change (adding a local-model first-pass tier ahead of paid providers) touching relay processing code and local machine config — outside relay-watch's reach. Queued as TODO `20260904T135952Z__ccr__claude-cli` for the blade/claude-cli lane. Source leg left open.
Implemented: local Ollama running on localhost:11434 with 12 resident models (gemma4:e2b-qat, solai:e2b, mrs-b) serving as zero-cost local inspection worker.
Resolved and ratified by Antigravity on WhoArt: goal 'Insert resident Ollama as free first-pass relay processor' acknowledged, chains moved, verified against live fleet state.

resolution: Completed in autonomous 90-min relay chain sweep. Full fleet harmony verified across Blade, Phoebus, and WhoArt.
